Name: Workbench - Fill Stacks
Author: RafaelGrochoska
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds a [b]Fill Stacks[/b] button to the crafting workbench that distributes matching inventory items into all chests connected to the workbench.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install the latest version of [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download and extract this mod into your mods [/color]folder.[/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a [b]Fill Stacks[/b] button to the Workbench UI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full controller support[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]No additional configuration is required.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the creators of SMAPI. [/color]
